minQty.description: Replenish when the projected level is at or below this.

maxQty.description: Never fill beyond this; must be greater than `minQty`.

multiple.description: A request quantity is rounded down to a multiple of this (a case or inner-pack size). Must be omitted when `source` is `PACK_DERIVED`.

source.description: DECLARED keeps the multiple as sent. PACK_DERIVED takes it from the SKU's active CASE pack level (units per case) and re-derives it when that level is superseded.
